down: Out of the fight and bleeding out. An adjacent ally can Stabilize; a medkit revives.
surrender: Gave up. Subdue it to take a prisoner.
captured: Bound and out of the fight.
guard: Deflects more bolts and strikes enemies who come close, until its next turn.
overwatch: Fires at the first enemy that moves in range.
hunker: +30 defense and immune to flanking crits until its next turn.
barrier: Counts as full cover from every side until the caster's next turn.
suppress: −30 aim; moving gives the suppressor a free shot.
scan: Get this unit to an evac zone to extract the data.
disarmed: Can't shoot next turn; can still move and melee.
concealed: Unseen by the enemy until it attacks or is spotted.
graze: A shot that just misses still clips the target for half damage. The band is 10% above the hit chance.
tired: Fought the last two missions back to back: −10 aim. Sit out one mission to recover.
panic: Lost its nerve: may freeze, flee or fire wildly.
darkness: Dark-side pull. High Darkness adds damage and risks a fall.

aim: Base chance to hit before cover, range and other modifiers.
move: Tiles per AP spent moving. 3 AP = triple distance.
damage: Damage range on a hit. Armor removes some; minimum 1.
range: Max shooting distance. Hit chance drops past 60% of it.
deflect: Chance a Jedi blocks a blaster bolt.
crit: Chance a hit deals +2 damage. Flanking adds more.
padawan: Within 3 tiles of their Master: +10 aim. A Padawan kill gives the Master +1 Focus.
armor: Each pip cuts one hit by 1, then breaks. Shredder strips an extra pip. Restored after every mission.
medkits: Heals or revives an adjacent ally.
hp: Health. At 0 a unit goes down and starts to bleed out.
actions: 3 AP per turn. Each AP buys one full move. Pistols and sabers cost 1 AP to attack, rifles 2; only Overwatch, Guard and Hunker end the turn.
focus: Fuel for Force powers. Meditate to regain it.
will: Resistance to panic from deaths, horrors and heavy damage.
stress: Builds over missions; high stress lowers will.
threat: Rises each turn past par. At 6 the mission fails.
